SUMMARY: The refactor replaces direct usage of `prometheus.Registerer` with a new `MetricsCollector` interface across two HTTP client middleware paths. This decouples metric registration from the concrete Prometheus registry, requiring any component registering HTTP client metrics to implement the interface. The change affects both generic HTTP client and plugin client middleware, plus their test files.

FILES:
- grafana/pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/prometheus_metrics_middleware.go — Core file to change; defines PrometheusMetrics and updates all prometheus.Registerer usages to MetricsCollector
- grafana/pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/prometheus_metrics_middleware_test.go — Tests must be updated to use MetricsCollector in Register/MustRegister call paths
- grafana/pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/datasource_metrics_middleware.go — Must be refactored to accept and use a MetricsCollector instead of implicit promauto registration
- grafana/pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/datasource_metrics_middleware_test.go — Tests must be updated to inject a MetricsCollector mock/stub
- grafana/pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/http_client_provider.go — Must pass a MetricsCollector to DataSourceMetricsMiddleware after signature change
- grafana/pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/http_client_provider_test.go — Tests may need updates if New signature changes to accept MetricsCollector
- grafana/pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware.go — Core file to change; replaces prometheus.Registerer parameter with MetricsCollector
- grafana/pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware_test.go — Must wrap prometheus.NewRegistry() in a MetricsCollector adapter
- grafana/pkg/services/pluginsintegration/pluginsintegration.go — Must change prometheus.Registerer parameters to MetricsCollector in ProvideClientWithMiddlewares and related functions
